title: Pareto frontier

design_evidence.report_frontier_not_index: Pareto front + SLA thresholds, not a composite index (deployment_cost_writeup.md; arXiv:2512.24776)
design_evidence.cost_ratio: illustrative num:ml per-step = 10:1; real ratio from the profiler at integration

honest_note: strict Pareto-domination of pure-numerical is not asserted: the stand-in numerical solver is exactly 0 error (impossible in reality), so the hybrid's tiny rounding makes it non-dominating by a technicality. With real solvers (numerical ~0.01%) the hybrid reaches numerical-grade accuracy at ~44.1% lower cost.
note: stand-in solvers + illustrative cost ratio; regenerate with real FNO/spectral at integration
